DitherDotMap.markers: Places to mark, each with lat, lon, an optional label shown beside it and an optional color.
DitherDotMap.arcs: Dotted lines between places, each with from-lat, from-lon, to-lat, to-lon and an optional color.
DitherDotMap.accent: Colour of markers, halos and arcs unless they set their own.
DitherDotMap.columns: Dots across the full width, at least 24.
DitherDotMap.halo: Radius in degrees of the glow each marker casts on the land. 0 turns it off.
DitherDotMap.ocean: Share of sea cells with a faint dot, 0 to 1.
DitherDotMap.bounds: The part of the world to draw, in degrees.
DitherDotMap.animated: Pulse the markers and run light along the arcs. false draws a still map.
